frequency_question: What proportion of major labor union dispute declarations successfully navigate all required statutory notice, cooling-off, and conciliation steps within a 35-day operational window?
membership_rule: Includes all formal industry-wide labor dispute declarations by major union coalitions requiring statutory conciliation and notice periods under industrial relations laws; excludes wildcat strikes or disputes without mandatory procedural prerequisites.
provenance_note: rate of 0% from only 4 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 4 named major industry-wide multi-union dispute cycles; all experienced procedural elongation exceeding 35 days due to mandatory conciliation and notice steps.
known_gaps: Minor localized or sectoral union actions excluded.
skeleton: Multi-tier dispute resolution processes consisting of: (1) Conciliation talks (minimum 14-21 days), (2) Formal strike ballot and tabulation (minimum 7-14 days), (3) Statutory strike notice delivery (minimum 14 days).
multiplier: Sequential mandatory steps totaling a minimum physical duration of 35 to 50 days under standard industrial relations procedural rules.
validity_reason: Statutory labor dispute frameworks and conciliation timelines remain stable under existing industrial relations legislation.
